finding.claim: SGML_DECL enters SGML_DECL_QUOTED without saving the quote char to parser.q, so the exit test `c === parser.q` can never succeed and the parser stays in quoted state.
finding.title: SGML_DECL_QUOTED never exits: missing parser.q assignment

verifier.reason: At sax.js:1357-1359 SGML_DECL transitions to SGML_DECL_QUOTED on isQuote(c) without assigning parser.q=c, unlike sax.js:1382-1384 and sax.js:1404-1407, while the only exit at sax.js:1365-1368 requires c === parser.q and clears parser.q to '' on exit, so the quoted state cannot terminate on the opening quote.

repro.reason: reproducer failed L0: controlCode assertion is not tied to a call of an imported symbol; testCode assertion is not tied to a call of an imported symbol; control and trigger must use a different input: no shared symbol is called in both codes
